title: The one-way migration door has no minimum-realisation floor, and the only discriminator that could supply one is deliberately discarded
description: _routeExit's return value is DISCARDED at :469. Nothing compares R against P except to cap it, so initiateMigration completes at ANY R including 0, irreversibly, and emits PrincipalDivergence(token, P, 0, 0) - byte-identical to a clean migration. _withdrawInternal debits the REQUESTED (capped) amount, so booked == 0 and the 'incomplete exit' post-check is satisfied by construction.
impact: No value is created or destroyed by the defect itself; the shortfall is external market loss on the vault position. The exposure is that a terminal, irreversible migration can latch at any R with no lower bound, no revert, and no observability discriminator.
recommendation: uint256 delivered = _routeExit(token, P, false); require(booked == 0 || delivered + booked >= P, "StableStaker: exit shortfall"); plus emitting `delivered`.
ratedLegs: no floor on R before the one-way Migrating latch
notRated: MR-15-S1 - received-decrementing custody adapter (C4 speculation on future code; PARKED, contributed nothing to this rating)
refutedFraming: 'A partially-failed exit can now proceed where V1 aborted' is REFUTED: AYieldStrategy._withdrawInternal debits the requested (capped) amount, so booked == 0 on a below-par exit and V1 proceeded too. NOT a regression; on the loss path V2 is strictly better for users than V1.
relatedNotSame: 7cdb92fdc7 - different contract:function, so this mints its own fingerprint legitimately.
keepRegardless: Tier-3 T3-02 confirms this residual as filed and states the mitigation should be kept REGARDLESS of DEDUP-15-01's disposition.
